originalTitle: A fourth private source for an old return after three fresh hosts
originalStatement: If q≤T bounds all earlier diagonals, three current fresh hosts precede an old return x≤T, then an increasing private-source path supplies a fourth distinct source for that same x and x+4≤T.

The current x at r lies right of h and below z. Inversion gives a new private x source at h. Its host differs from all three fresh hosts because its current valuez≤T, whereas theirs exceedT.
